main.description: A media reference curated into a radio: a URL with a title, a description and #tags.

description.description: Free text. #tags and @mentions are parsed from it.

duration.description: Media duration in seconds, when known.

playbackError.description: Set when the media could not be played, e.g. a removed video.

r4Id.description: ID of the track on radio4000.com, when imported from there.
